purpose: Approved external sources for CARSI course content and marketing, tiered by evidential authority. Exists so an E-E-A-T claim is checkable rather than asserted: content that cites tier-1 primary sources demonstrates expertise, content that cites only suppliers demonstrates a catalogue.
seededFrom: Domains already cited in data/seed and docs/course-content, enumerated 2026-08-07. Nothing here is aspirational - every tier-1 and tier-3 entry was already in use.

rules.iicrcStandardText: NEVER reproduce IICRC standard text, and never enter it into AI tooling. The IICRC's published AI Use Policy prohibits both. iicrc.org is registered for NOMINATIVE reference only (naming a standard or a certification third-person). Enforced separately by src/lib/course-kit/standards-excerpt.ts.
rules.absenceClaims: Never claim a standard omits something. Absence cannot be proven from a section index - state what the standard DOES say. See CLAUDE.md, 2026-07-15 incident.
rules.supplierSources: Tier 4 is citable for product specification and availability. It is NOT evidence for a safety, health or regulatory claim, and does not count toward authority ratio.
rules.unregistered: A domain absent from this registry is not banned - it is unvetted. Add it with a tier and a reason, or replace the citation.

tiers.1: Primary Australian regulator, legislator or standards body. Highest authority for a compliance or safety claim.
tiers.2: Peer-reviewed research or an international public-health body. Authority for a scientific claim.
tiers.3: Industry certifying body. Nominative reference only.
tiers.4: Manufacturer, supplier or distributor. Product specification and availability only.
